entities.summary: Ralf Rocchigiani is a German former professional boxer who competed from 1983 to 1999. He held the World Boxing Organisation (WBO) cruiserweight title from 1995 to 1997. At regional level, he held the German title twice between 1985 and 1994. He is the older brother of former two-division world champion boxer, Graciano Rocchigiani.
